`final class MsdfGenerator`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.tool.msdf` · **Module:** `tool-msdf` · **Source:** [MsdfGenerator.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/tool/msdf/src/main/java/dev/joid/tool/msdf/MsdfGenerator.java)

Generates the MSDF atlas of a font file, as a `font.msdf` file that JOID loads without generating it again.

## Description

JOID calls it at the first load of a font file and caches the result; run it from the command line to ship the atlases ready.

## Learn more

- [Generate MSDF atlases before you ship](/use/learn/going-further/fonts/#generate-msdf-atlases-before-you-ship)
- [MSDF text](/use/in-depth/msdf-text/)

## Method details

<a id="MsdfGenerator-method-main"></a>

### main

`void main(String[] arguments)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

**Throws:**

- `IllegalArgumentException`: Usage: msdf --font &lt;file.ttf|file.otf&gt; [--output &lt;directory&gt;] [--charset &lt;file|ranges&gt;] [--range &lt;pixels&gt;] [--width &lt;pixels&gt;] [--height &lt;pixels&gt;] [--size &lt;pixels&gt;]

Reads the options `--font` (required), `--output`, `--charset`, `--range`, `--width`, `--height` and `--size`, then writes `font.msdf` into the output folder and prints a summary that starts with `[JOID]`.
Throws an `IllegalArgumentException` with the usage for a missing font or an unknown option, and when an option has no value.

<a id="MsdfGenerator-method-generate"></a>

### generate

`String generate(byte[] data, File target, int[] codepoints, int width, int height, double range, double requested)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Writes the atlas of the font bytes into the file, with the glyphs of those code points that the font draws, at that atlas size in pixels and that distance range in pixels, and returns a one-line summary.
A requested glyph size of `0D` or less takes the largest size that fits; a larger one throws an `IllegalStateException` when the glyphs do not fit at it.

<a id="MsdfGenerator-method-codepoints"></a>

### codepoints

`int[] codepoints(String charset)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

**Throws:**

- `IllegalArgumentException`: The charset … is neither a file nor codepoints like [32, 126], 8364: check the path or separate the values with commas

Returns the code points of a charset: the path of a file that holds one, or ranges and values such as `[32, 126], 8364`.
Throws an `IllegalArgumentException` when the text is neither.
